preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 100.
The lengths of strings s and t must be equal.
String s must be lexicographically smaller than string t.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No such string' or (s < stdout < t)
postconditions.description: If no valid string exists, output 'No such string'; otherwise, output a string that is lexicographically between s and t.
